## What landed

- **`ops/src/ops/release_verify.py`** — the suite-B half of the §5.5
  table on suite A's harness: `CHECKS_S` = V1–V15, `CHECKS_P` =
  V1,V3,V4,V5,V7,V10,V13,P1 (`P_V10_SAMPLE = 20`, `P1_MAX_AGE_DAYS = 35`).
  `VerifyContext` gains `api_fetcher` / `previous_dir` / `previous_pub` /
  `covers` / `quality_report` / `v10_sample` / `cadence_path`;
  `TreeFetcher` gains `deny_conf` + `tombstone_root` + `conf_gen_header`
  — the deny map answers `410` + the route's own `sig.tombstone/1` body
  before any origin byte, the same answer nginx gives.
  - **V6 number truth** — every `data-artifact` figure element in `v/`+
    `s/` must be figure-manifest-listed, resolve under the release's
    `artifact/` space, and recompute: JSON-pointer value = rendered
    `data-figure-value`, artifact as-of = the release `as_of_world`.
    Unevaluable surface → skip (blocks).
  - **V7 API parity** — `release_publish_verify.api_parity_check` for the
    staged half (P35.57's own verdict — deferred honoured, never
    re-implemented); the served half compares every `r/<pub>/api/` slice
    document byte-equal as canonical JSON, checks `/` + `/health` name
    the release and live-spine routes carry their basis. No API surface
    → skip (blocks).
  - **V8 attribution sanity** — 0 `attribution_required` rows with empty
    attribution; `LICENCES.json` per compartment; map pages name the
    upstream `map_contributor` holders; no source renders a bare id or a
    `policy.source_aliases` handle-shaped name.
  - **V9 jurisdiction–coordinate sanity** — 0 null-island/out-of-range
    points; the `covers` oracle catches axis swaps (swapped pair inside,
    true pair outside — the mark43/Nottingham class); out-of-boundary
    points withheld or disclosed-conflict; dossier rollup counts equal
    the bulk recompute. Points without an oracle → skip (blocks).
  - **V10 withdrawal barrier** — the expected deny set re-derived over a
    throwaway registry mirror and diffed against the served generation's
    `withdrawn.conf`; every alias (S) or all-new-since-last-release + a
    deterministic 20-sample (P) probed for `410` + its own tombstone
    body; `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` = the recorded generation.
  - **V14 diff sanity** — the six deltas vs the current latest (records
    per compartment, source set, licence set, route set, template
    fingerprint, version/schema) emitted as evidence; the §7.3 bounds
    fail; the classifier stays row 337's.
  - **V15 quality hook** — `sig.quality-report/1` (dict or path; absent
    → skip, blocks) → `exports.quality.run_release_gate` verbatim:
    verdict, enforce failures, not-evaluable legs, ratchet regressions,
    and the `class_s` signal surface in the evidence.
  - **P1 hosted probes** — `/releases/latest.json` = `/release.json` pub;
    release age < 35 d; served `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` = recorded gen;
    `ops/cadence.toml` declares the `sig-release-*` kinds + an
    `absent-api-release-*` target.
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py` + `ops/cadence.toml`** — the
  `RELEASE_PROBE_KINDS` checks (`check_release`: pointer parity, age
  bound, conf-gen match) dispatched by `probe_hosted` with the spec's
  `max_age_days`/`trigger`; an unreachable origin records status-0 red,
  never a crash. `cadence.toml` declares `sig-release-pointer`,
  `sig-release-age` (35 d), `sig-conf-gen`,
  `absent-api-release-unpromoted` — each with cadence + trigger.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_conf.py`** — `verb_promote`'s post-check failure
  path is the pre-authorised one: `failed` journaled, promote lock
  released, then `release_reversal.verb_rollback` to the prior latest
  (`verb_clear_latest` on a first release) under the `d-g3-8` authority —
  a **new immutable conf generation**, history never edited — plus a
  recorded `release-auto-rollback` alert and an append-only
  `registry/incidents/` note + `incident` journal event naming the
  failure, the D-G3-8/B-9 citation, the rollback outcome and the alert.
  A refused/failed rollback records verbatim; the promote still raises
  `post-check-failed`. `auto_rollback=False` keeps the pre-row posture;
  `rollback_runner`/`alert_hook` are the test seams. Resume edge closed:
  a crashed-then-resumed promote reads the restore target from the failed
  generation's own `latest.json` `previous` — never a `same-latest`
  refusal that leaves the failed candidate serving.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_pipeline.py` / `cli.py`** — `release verify`
  gains `--api-origin`/`--api-header`/`--quality-report`/`--cadence`;
  the tree origin wires the conf generation's deny map, tombstones and
  `X-SIG-Conf-Gen`; `probe-hosted` severities read the declared trigger
  and red release probes alert through the recorded channel.

## Tests

- `tests/ops/test_release_verify_b.py` — **55 tests**: a planted defect
  per check (figure mismatch/unmanifested artifact/stale as-of; parity +
  basis + slice failures; empty attribution, licence-less compartment,
  bare-id and handle-shaped renders; null island, axis swap, undisclosed
  out-of-boundary, lying rollup; unserved deny, wrong tombstone, lying
  conf-gen, P-mode new+sample; compartment breach, dropped source,
  first-release skip; enforce failure, not-evaluable, ratchet → Class S,
  absent report blocking; pointer/age/gen/cadence P1 legs) plus the
  auto-rollback catalog AC verbatim — fixture promote → planted post-check
  failure → `rollback` to the prior gen + alert record + incident note —
  first-release clear-latest, a legacy-floor serve restored by label,
  refused-rollback recording, the crash-resume restore, dry-run
  non-mutation, `auto_rollback=False`, and the injected runner recorded
  verbatim.
- `tests/ops/test_release_verify.py` — the suite-B fixture surface
  (figure artifact, sources/LICENCES indices, map attribution, a real
  prior staged release for V14, `_ApiFixture`, `_quality_report`); the
  honest P fixture still reports exactly `D-P35.56-1` and nothing else.
- `tests/e2e/test_release_verify_composed.py` — the composed suite now
  exercises V7/V15/P1 end-to-end through a real loopback `http.server`
  fixture.
